evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: EasyPostman provides developers with a **local, privacy-first** API debugging experience comparable to Postman, plus simplified JMeter-style performance testing. Built with Java Swing for cross-platform support, it works completely offline and includes built-in Git workspace support for team collaboration and version control.

evidence.title: README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: | 🎯 Focus on Core | 🔒 Privacy First | 🚀 Performance | |:---:|:---:|:---:| | Simple yet powerful, rich features without bloat | 100% local storage, no cloud sync, your data stays private | Native Java app, fast startup, smooth experience |

evidence.title: README (segment 8)
evidence.excerpt: ### 🏢 Workspace & Collaboration - **Local Workspace** - Personal projects with local storage - **Git Workspace** - Version control and team collaboration - **Multi-device Sync** - Share API data via Git repositories - **Project Isolation** - Each workspace manages its own collections and environments
